meaning: reports/release.json production_status and release_ready only say the route passed Synth's router and DRC gates. They are not review sign-off. This file stays false until every gate below is true.

erc_dispositioned.evidence: Every ERC finding is dispositioned below by the author. passed stays false until a human reviewer confirms the dispositions.

findings.disposition: Fixed. VIO is fed by the J_VIO jumper from +3V3 or VBUS, and jumper pins are passive, so no pin on the rail is a power output. The exporter now places a PWR_FLAG on VIO (it used to anchor it on U1, which has no stock symbol, and drop it). With no jumper fitted VIO is unpowered by design.
Not a design fault. The exported schematic uses the embedded symbols and the KiCad run had no 'power' library configured.
Not a design fault. The footprints are embedded in the PCB and the KiCad run had no global footprint libraries such as Connector_USB.
Benign. The MODEM_IDLE bus is drawn as several overlapping segments of the same net, so its label touches more than one wire. All of them are MODEM_IDLE.

Fixed. The MODEM_IDLE name label sat where the RXD1_MCU flag stub crosses the MODEM_IDLE bus, so KiCad joined the two nets. The exporter now moves a name label off other nets' wires (one label moved from y 49.53 to 48.26 mm), and the ERC finding is gone. The routed PCB already had them as separate nets.

jlcpcb_dfm.evidence: Partial. The gerber, BOM and CPL were uploaded to JLCPCB's quote flow on 2026-10-27 without paying or ordering. JLCPCB accepted the board and the BOM and CPL were matched, but its trace and space, drill, edge-clearance and via-in-pad findings were not captured and nobody asked JLCPCB about the filled and capped via. passed stays false until those are recorded.
jlcpcb_dfm.selected: 2 layers, FR-4 TG135, 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer copper, HASL with lead, green mask, white silkscreen, 5 boards. Assembly: Economic, top side, 5 boards.
findings: JLCPCB read the gerber zip as a 2-layer board of 32.23 x 40.99 mm, the same as the committed board.

The CPL covers SMD parts only. J2, J3, J4, J_VIO (pin headers) and H1 to H4 (mounting holes) are not in it, so JLCPCB reported them as missing and Economic assembly does not place them. The headers need hand soldering.

On the first upload JLCPCB matched 21 of 28 lines. The BOM has no LCSC numbers, so it matched by value and footprint, and the other 7 were chosen by hand: D1 PRTR5V0U2X,215 (C12333), D2 D5 D6 PTVS6V0S1UR,115 (C294622), U2 LP5907MFX-3.3/NOPB (C80670), R_TERM 0603WAF1200T5E (C22787), R_TNOW 0603WAF4701T5E (C23162). After that all 28 lines show as matched and confirmed.

The automatic match for D4 and D7 was TZ-P2-0603YGTCS1-0.6T (C916074), a yellow-green LED, but these are the red TX LEDs. They were changed by hand to KT-0603R (C2286, red 615 to 630 nm). The D3 match VLMTG1401-GS08 (C511604) was not checked for colour.

Warnings still shown: the resistor comments (for example 5.1k) differ from the matched part number (0603WAF5101T5E), and the matched LED line is used for more than one designator. Resistor values were compared by hand and agree.

LED polarity: in KiCad, D4 pad 1 (the left pad, the cathode of the LED footprint) is on net TXD0, as the design intends. JLCPCB's placement preview shows the cathode tick on the left end of D4 and D7, which is consistent, but this was read from a zoomed screenshot, D7 was not opened in KiCad, and JLCPCB has not confirmed the polarity of KT-0603R. Rotation of the other polarised parts (D1, D2, D5, D6, U1, U2, U3) was not checked.
None of these matches is a component review. They were picked from JLCPCB's search for DFM purposes.

reproducible_from_clean_checkout.evidence: Three exports on 2026-10-26 of the committed inputs gave a byte-identical kicad_pcb and kicad_sch (FreeRouting 2.4.1, KiCad 10.0.5, empty XDG_DATA_HOME, `--router free-routing --krt-allow-via-in-pad`, Synth with #306 and #319). The third ran from a fresh `git worktree` checkout of the committing commit, with the untracked FreeRouting jar and JRE linked in from `tools/`. All match the committed files, except that the schematic was regenerated afterwards from an unrouted export with the VIO PWR_FLAG added (its hash above is the current one; the PCB was not re-exported). DRC: 0 errors, 0 unconnected, 37 warnings. Not tested on another machine or another FreeRouting version, so the result may differ there.

layout_clearances.evidence: The silkscreen warnings are fixed: the D7, J4, J_VIO and U1 reference labels are placed in the sidecar and kicad-cli DRC reports none. One item stays open.

findings.item: J1 courtyard to top board edge
findings.disposition: Open for independent mechanical approval. Checked against the HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 drawing (C165948): the footprint puts the shell front face 0.50 mm inside Edge.Cuts (y -0.06 against the edge at y -0.56), and the 0.01 mm is only the F.CrtYd margin of 0.5 mm reaching the edge, so nothing of the connector body crosses it. The drawing gives the front edge as the layout datum and states no overhang or recess limit. A 0.50 mm recess of the plug face needs an enclosure cutout check, which has not been done.
